hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (lines 173-192) compares each reservation input against level.available_quantity on its own and never sums inputs sharing an (inventory_item_id, location_id). Two carts that each hold WIDGET on more than one line (OVS-PIECE and OVS-TWOPACK, sharing the WIDGET item with stock 10) should both pass the per-line check when their combined need exceeds 10, if they reach the reservation step concurrently. I expect at least some runs to show live reservations summing past stock, failing no_oversell, while reserved_matches_reservations still holds since the counter is incremented consistently under the lock.
